hw.park.welcome.lines.01.text: Welcome to Halloween Park! Let’s play hide-and-seek!

hw.park.welcome.lines.02.text: The pirate is hiding. Let’s find him!

hw.park.find-pirate.hint.01.text: Look around the park. Can you see him?

hw.park.find-pirate.retry.01.text: Take another look. Where is the pirate?

hw.park.find-mermaid.retry.01.text: Take another look. Where is the mermaid?

hw.park.gold-request.lines.02.text: It has red eyes and bat wings!

hw.park.find-gold.hint.01.text: Look around the park. Can you see the red eyes?

hw.park.find-gold.retry.01.text: Look carefully. Where is my vampire ring?
